description: This file defines a command handler class for deleting report mailing jobs within the Fineract platform. It implements the interface for processing commands and delegates the delete operation to the associated service.

classes.name: DeleteReportMailingJobCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles delete commands for report mailing jobs by implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, and delegates deletion to the write platform service.

methods.name: DeleteReportMailingJobCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the ReportMailingJobWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command by invoking the delete method on the write platform service with the provided entity ID.
